limits: Counters are exact published count batches, asynchronously drained; durations are deterministic one-in32 samples per event key, not all calls.
No percentile interpolation or 32x extrapolation. Histogram intervals aggregate target/service; outcomes are not a histogram label.
New/disappeared/reset series remain unknown, not zero. Process-start identity is checked only if present in these same captures.
Each file is a non-atomic scrape/cut; not exactly the earlier trace window, no same-RPC/request/reply association.
Scheduler priority queues mix frame kinds/services/directions; admission/canceled cannot identify a response or particular READ.
Resource gauges are two/latest samples, not peak/headroom; no additional resource probe.
